# Detect and repair a stale projection, then verify JSON status.
exec weft$exe init
exec weft$exe add 'Refresh the board view' --state todo

cp stale-projection.md WEFT.md
cp WEFT.md projection-before-check.md
exitcode 1 check --json
json
stdout '"ok": false'
stdout 'projection is stale; run weft sync'
stderr 'found 1 board issue'
cmp WEFT.md projection-before-check.md

exec weft$exe sync --json
json
stdout '"synced": true'
stdout '"task_count": 1'
! stderr .+
exec weft$exe check --json
json
stdout '"ok": true'
grep 'Refresh the board view' WEFT.md

-- stale-projection.md --
# Stale projection
